cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys,collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
from ref import Image
import fuzz
rng=__import__('random').Random(99)
ops=fuzz.gen_case(rng, style='deep', nputs=200)
body=json.dumps({"cases":[{"ops":ops+[['save'],['load_saved',0]]}]},separators=(',',':'))
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'run.py'],input=body.encode(),cwd='/workspace',capture_output=True)
resp=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
img=resp['results'][0]['snapshots'][0]
print('cells',img['cells'],'rows',sum(len(b) for b in img['banks']))
I=Image(img)
print('types',collections.Counter(n['type'] for n in I.nodes))
print('bulk children total', sum(bin(n.get('bulk_bitmap',0)).count('1') for n in I.nodes))
print('direct children total', sum(len(n['children']) for n in I.nodes))
print('nodes', len(I.nodes), 'prefixes', len(I.prefixes))
